});\n1992: \t\t\t\t\tsortedArray = new int[sortList.Count];\n1993: \t\t\t\t\tfor (int i = 0; i < sortedArray.Length; i++)\n1994: \t\t\t\t\t\tsortedArray[i] = sortList[i].Value;\n1995: \t\t\t\t}\n1996: \t\t\t\telse\n1997: \t\t\t\t{\n1998: \t\t\t\t\tList<KeyValuePair<string, int>> sortList = new List<KeyValuePair<string, int>>();\n1999: \t\t\t\t\tstring[] array = (string[])varTerm.Identifier.GetArray();\n2000: \t\t\t\t\tfor (int i = 0;
